.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1033 mb high was over western Montana and a 1009 mb 
low was over Puerto Penasco, Mexico. Weak offshore flow near 
shore during the nights and mornings will alternate with onshore 
northwest flow during the afternoons and evenings through Tuesday.
More steady onshore flow expected by Wednesday.
